kreno.config.title: Kreno Config
kreno.config.entry.compress.compressionL: The compression level for packets, between 1-9.
kreno.config.entry.fix.issues128.sync.de: Run bandwidth statistics on sync thread, which is closer to Vanilla behaviour.
kreno.config.entry.mixin.textFilterVT.de: Replace text filter thread with virtual thread
kreno.config.entry.mixin.utilVT.desc: Replace download thread with virtual thread
kreno.config.entry.mixin.clientEncrypt.d: Enable new encryption optimisations on the client side
kreno.config.entry.mixin.serverEntityMov: Skips sending movement packets if the entity hasn't moved, and downgrades position+rotation packets to just rotation if the entity only turned.
kreno.config.entry.mixin.packetProcessor: Halves concurrent queue operations when draining queued packets on the main thread.
kreno.config.entry.mixin.particlePacketO: Reduces some potentially useless particle packets. This configuration only takes effect on the server side.
kreno.config.entry.mixin.trackedEntityOp: Optimises entity packet broadcasting and integrates with server-side entity culling to reduce network overhead.
kreno.config.entry.netty.allocatorMaxOrd: Change Netty's default 16MiB memory allocation to 4MiB, as Minecraft has a 2MiB packet size limit.
kreno.config.entry.netty.happyEyeballs.d: Enable Happy Eyeballs (RFC 8305) for client connections to race IPv6 and IPv4. May cause some servers (like Velocity) to temporarily refuse connections.
kreno.config.entry.gui.oreui.desc: Replace Minecraft style KReno UI with a newly designed OreUI
kreno.config.entry.culling.entity.desc: Smart entity culling on server side
kreno.config.entry.culling.particle.desc: Smart particle culling on server side
kreno.config.entry.culling.asyncMode.des: Asynchronous execution mode for the culling system
